Quīntīlis

Quīntīlis, Quīntīle

adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)

July (the old name)

In this lexicon

  • July

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 5.12.1: mēnse Quīntīlī; Liv. 9.46 (Īdibus Quīntīlibus, Lewis & Short); Traupman 78

Notes

  1. 1Quīntīlis: long first i (Lewis & Short leaves it unmarked). From quīntus. De Vaan 509, s.v. quīnque: the vowel of the ordinal was lengthened before the spirantized k (*kwīxto- > quīntus), and the long ī spread to quīnque. Traupman 78 marks Quīntīlis. Ruling: Which authority settles a vowel.
